svg.aria-label: The first round of the referee skill. Boxes: You answer the intake (stop); Field analyst: the Reviewer Configuration Card (agent); You confirm the reviewer configuration (stop); EIC, 2 calls (agent); Methodology reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Domain reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Perspective reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Devil's Advocate reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Referee: the selection and the left-out comments (agent); You confirm the selection or move comments (stop); Referee, resumed: the referee report (agent).

svg.text: name. The second round starts the field analyst and the EIC, which checks the revision against the authors' response, and the five reviewers only when you ask for them at the intake. Its
